draft.title: llm_client: EnvironmentError not raised on whitespace-only API key
draft.body:
## Summary

On iteration 1, `test_whitespace_key` failed because `_get_client()` does not strip whitespace before checking for an empty API key.

## Root Cause

`_get_client()` in `src/llm_client.py` uses `if not api_key` which evaluates `'   '` as truthy, so a whitespace-only key passes the guard without raising `EnvironmentError`.

## Affected Files

- `src/llm_client.py`

## Suggested Fix

Change `api_key = os.getenv('GEMINI_API_KEY', '')` to `api_key = os.getenv('GEMINI_API_KEY', '').strip()`

## Confidence

High

## Context

**Goal:** test that llm_client.generate() raises EnvironmentError when GEMINI_API_KEY is missing

_Recovered in iteration 2 after the test plan was regenerated with the whitespace case explicitly covered. Issue drafted for documentation._
